name: Grave-Tally Banneret
rationale: A back-rank warrior counts the fallen into stored power, raising supported allies higher with every claimed memory.

name: Twinbeat Adept
rationale: This fast character lives in the rhythm of a second spell, catching the doubled pulse to trade one thought for another.

name: Unburied Roadwarden
rationale: The support figure returns from the void to clear a path, lending unstoppable force to the allies marching ahead.

name: Echo-Drill Captain
rationale: A martial trainer turns each materialized figment into practiced momentum, spending those echoes for tactical insight.

name: Veilbarter Medium
rationale: A veiled broker trades one possible character for another of equal weight, treating identity as a hidden-market token.

name: Borrow Tomorrow's Dawn
rationale: The event steals the next morning from the dream's horizon, creating a decisive extra turn before time can close.

name: Void-Cradle Tender
rationale: This caretaker coaxes small lost characters back from the void once each turn, making recurrence feel careful rather than grand.

name: Stormglass Bellringer
rationale: Each event charges the bell with gathering pressure until its fifth peal washes every other character back to hand.
